theorem offG {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) (r : R) : Off (layG pp r) (Api.Exptmod.hin pp) := by
  cases r
  · exact hP.off .stk
  · exact hP.off .gS
  · exact hP.off .gD
  · exact hP.off .xS
  · exact hP.off .xD
  · exact hP.off .nS
  · exact hP.off .nD
  · exact hP.off .yS
  · exact hP.off .yD
  · exact hP.off .ks
  · exact hP.off .ts
  · exact hP.off .kc
  · exact hP.off .tc
  · exact hP.off .code
  all_goals exact Off.nil _

theorem posG {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) (y : Y) :
    0 < (ρ3 pp y).len ∨ (ρ3 pp y).base < heapStart ∨ heapEnd ≤ (ρ3 pp y).base := by
  have := hP.res.gpos; have := hP.res.xpos; have := hP.res.npos; have := hP.res.ypos; have := MpExptmod.frame_lt_F pp
  rcases y with _ | _ | _ | r
  rotate_left 3
  · cases r
    · left; unfold ρ3; simp [Split.lay, layG_stk]; omega
    · left; show 0 < 24; decide
    · left; show 0 < 4 * pp.g.alloc; omega
    · left; show 0 < 24; decide
    · left; show 0 < 4 * pp.x.alloc; omega
    · left; show 0 < 24; decide
    · left; show 0 < 4 * pp.n.alloc; omega
    · left; show 0 < 24; decide
    · left; show 0 < 4 * pp.y.alloc; omega
    · left; show 0 < 4; decide
    · left; show 0 < 4; decide
    · left; show 0 < 4; decide
    · left; show 0 < 4; decide
    · left; show 0 < textLen; decide
    all_goals (right; left; show Iv.nil.base < heapStart; decide)
  all_goals (left; unfold ρ3; simp [Split.lay, layG_stk])

/-- The heap checkpoint at the entry. -/
theorem entry_hp {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) :
    HP (ρX pp) wX (Api.Exptmod.hin pp) (Api.Exptmod.hin pp) (InAny (Api.Exptmod.lay (MpExptmod.F pp) pp) Api.Exptmod.ws) mm mm := by
  have hF : 96 ≤ (layG pp .stk).len := by rw [layG_stk]; exact MpExptmod.frame_le_F pp
  have hstk : Ram (layG pp .stk).base (layG pp .stk).len := (hP.bund .stk).2
  refine HP.entry hP.heap (fun y => (offG hP (proj y)).sub (sub3 hF y) (posG hP y)) ?_ ?_
  · intro y hy q hq
    have hs := sub3 hF y
    have hq2 : (ρ3 pp y).In q := hq
    have hq' : (layG pp (proj y)).In q := by unfold Iv.Sub Iv.In at *; omega
    rcases y with _ | _ | _ | r
    rotate_left 3
    · cases r <;> simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isWG] at hy
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.Exptmod.R.stk) (by decide) hq'
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.Exptmod.R.yS) (by decide) hq'
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.Exptmod.R.yD) (by decide) hq'
      all_goals (exfalso; have h1 : 0x80000000 ≤ q := hq'.1; have h2 : q < 0x80000000 + 0 := hq'.2; omega)
    all_goals exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.Exptmod.R.stk) (by decide) hq'
  · intro y hy
    have hs := sub3 hF y
    rcases y with _ | _ | _ | r
    rotate_left 3
    · cases r <;> simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isWG] at hy
      · exact Ram.sub hstk hs.1 hs.2
      · show Ram pp.py 24
        simpa [Layout.sizeofMpInt] using (Hdr.geom (show Hdr mm pp.py pp.ydp pp.y from (hP.bund .yS).2)).st
      · show Ram pp.ydp (4 * pp.y.alloc)
        exact (show Dig mm pp.ydp pp.y.alloc pp.y.digit from (hP.bund .yD).2).ram
      all_goals exact Ram.nil
    all_goals exact Ram.sub hstk hs.1 hs.2

/-- The written regions are RAM over the generated layout (`HP.flatE` before a tail call). -/
theorem ramG {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) (r : R) (hr : isWG r = true) :
    Ram (layG pp r).base (layG pp r).len := by
  cases r <;> simp [isWG] at hr
  · exact (hP.bund .stk).2
  · show Ram pp.py 24
    simpa [Layout.sizeofMpInt] using (Hdr.geom (show Hdr mm pp.py pp.ydp pp.y from (hP.bund .yS).2)).st
  · show Ram pp.ydp (4 * pp.y.alloc)
    exact (show Dig mm pp.ydp pp.y.alloc pp.y.digit from (hP.bund .yD).2).ram
  all_goals exact Ram.nil
